name: @workspace-clients/chat-mobile
//dependencies: react is 19.0.0 and react-native 0.79.7, the pair the installed host's react-native-renderer accepts; they move together with clients/mobile-browser. The device credential, the connection, push and every other device-owned module belong to the host runtime; this client imports only @vibestudio/rn-client-api for them.
//capabilities: device-session and hub-control are the whole required set: the conversation runs on this device's session in the Personal workspace, which the client finds through the account's hub control. notifications and notifications.reply are optional: conversation notifications and their lock-screen reply field are drawn and relayed by the host, so chat works without them. clipboard and open-external serve copy buttons and links in agent prose.
//intents: open-conversation has no dynamic entries: no workspace service lists recent conversations yet, so a launcher offers a plain Chat entry and the conversation list lives inside the client.

vibestudio.description: Talk with agents in your workspace from your phone: your conversations, shared text and quick questions from the lock screen.
